$schema_note: CC 2.6.1 (CIRISConstitution rc20 0c9e17c, the clean mesh; manifests/signed_object_v2.cddl) edition-2 row statement known answers, v4 (v3 with rc21's own-voice key records, CC 2.4.1.1, and body decimals, CC 2.6.1.4; family cases under CIRISConstitution v1.0-rc20 d4bd2a6). Keys: ML-DSA-65 seed = [n]*32, Ed25519 seed = [n+100]*32 for key_seed n. Signatures are deterministic (FIPS 204 deterministic variant; Ed25519). Generated independently of the Rust code by its own CBOR encoder over dilithium-py and pyca/cryptography; see README.md beside this file. Every case states its level: statement (verify_row_statement, no family model; key_directory through a key-record directory), family (verify_row_in_family under the named model: test or vendored), object (verify_object_statement), payload (check_key_record) or value (classify_reference). Every valid case is also valid at the family level under the vendored model (family_vendored_expect). expect: valid, waiting:kid:<kid>, waiting:voice:<kid> (the key's own voice over a held record), waiting:covering_record:<kid>:<at_ms>, or invalid:<reason>[:<member>]. family_model is a stated test model. family_vendored is read under CC's family_authorship.json (v1.0-rc20 d4bd2a6) by CC's selector evaluator (tools/cc_family_select.py): the leaf from the row's dimension, and verb, identity, group, seats and act from the case's optional ctx (absent: unknown), except that act is never a payload member and the reader derives it when the ctx leaves it out (CC 2.6.1.9): a case's act states the derived act (own, none, or withheld where read is as_given and nothing is derived). family_vendored_groups reads each case's statements together (verify_group_row_in_family, act group): expect is each voice's verdict, or several_rows.

family.description: The author signs its own authored row.
An authored family whose payload has no author.
A counted family whose payload names an author.
A signer other than the author, in no role.
A signer other than the author, named as the delegate.
The delegate member names someone else.
-70002 names no family the CC registry registers (refused before any family model).
A family that scores a dimension, without one.

family_vendored.description: self:delegates_to: the delegate (CWT sub) signs the author's payload.
self:delegates_to: a signer other than the author who is not the sub.
key:record, act own (derived): a signer other than the author, and the row names no predecessor: no role admits it.

key:record's predecessor_key is by target: the issuer of the row refs.target names (CC 3.1.3), which the row does not carry; a payload member target naming the signer does not admit it from the vendored model.
key:record, act own (derived from the one statement, its author's): authored; its author signs.
key:record with no author, one statement read alone: a voice of a counted row gives no act alone, so arm 0 (act=group) is unknown (see family_vendored_groups for the row read together).
key:record read as given with act withheld (a harness): arm 0 is unknown.
group:roster is counted: no author (a founding version; its group is the derived id).
group:roster with an author.
accord:* arm 0 is leaf=lifecycle:{kind}; with no dimension the leaf is unknown, so the arm is unknown before the decider and the authorship is undetermined.
licensure:{authority_id} (rc20: act=group => counted ; authored), act own (derived): authored; its author signs.
licensure:{authority_id} read as given with act withheld (a harness): arm 0 is unknown.
membership:{stage}: leaf widening holds arm 0 (leaf=widening|removal): counted, no author.
membership:widening is counted: an author is refused.
membership:{stage}: leaf proposal reads arm 0 false, so the `*` arm decides: authored.
membership:proposal is authored: a row with no author is refused.
membership:{stage} with no dimension: arm 0 is unknown.
accord:lifecycle:{kind} (the family accord:lifecycle:confirmed:v1 resolves to; under accord:* the same dimension binds leaf lifecycle:confirmed and arm 0 holds): counted.
collection:{kind} with act=group: arm 0 holds, counted.
collection:{kind} with act=own: arm 0 is false, authored.
collection:{kind} with act=own is authored: a row with no author is refused.
collection:{kind} with act not supplied: derived own from the one statement of a row with an author, so arm 0 is false: authored.
collection:{kind} read as given with act withheld (a harness): arm 0 is unknown.
identity:occurrence_revocation with identity {user}: counted.
identity:occurrence_revocation with identity {node}: arm 0 false, authored.
quarantine:{state} with group=affiliations and seats=1: counted.
quarantine:{state} with group=family and seats not supplied: group reads false, so arm 0 is false whatever seats reads, and the `*` arm decides: authored.
trust:{job}:{version}, leaf confers, act=own: the delegate (CWT sub) role's when holds.
trust:{job}:{version}, leaf accepts: the delegate role's when is false.
trust:{job}:{version} with no dimension and act=own: authored, but the roles' when is unknown, so no second signer is admitted.
retirement:{state}, leaf retired: the custodian role's when holds, but the payload has no custodian member naming the signer.
retirement:{state}, leaf retired: the custodian role (rc20: by custodian) admits the signer the payload's custodian names.
self:delegates_to's delegate_owner role is by owner_of_sub, the owner the owner-binding of sub names; a payload member of that name does not admit the signer.

family_vendored_groups.description: key:record signed by two voices over one payload with no author: act group, arm 0 holds, counted; each voice is valid and both name one row.
licensure:{authority_id} signed by two voices over one payload: act group, counted.
An authored key:record read as a group: act group is counted, and the row names an author.
Two key:record statements over different payloads are not one row.

key_directory.description: B's record signed by B, beside A's own: Valid.
B's record signed by A and by B: B's own voice makes it live.
B's record signed by A alone (v3's held_through_chain): no third party makes a key live (CC 2.4.1.1), so the statement waits on B's own voice over that record.
B's record signed by G alone, whom nobody holds (v3's deep_waiting): it waits on B's own voice, not on G.
B's own record has no valid_until on a node: the key, and the statement, are Invalid.
A statement asserted after B's own record's valid_until: no held record of B covers the instant, so it waits on one that does (CC 2.4.1.1: retryable).

key_records.description: node, one millisecond past the bound.
node, one second past the bound.
valid_until equal to asserted_at: the span [asserted_at, valid_until) covers nothing (rc21).
agent with no valid_until (the private-room exception fails closed).
A set mixing user and node.
A role outside both groups takes no end rule.
An accord holder's key: hardware_class names the Ed25519 half, pq_custody removable_offline (CC 4.2.2).
hardware_class without pq_custody: carried (the consumer weighs it at 0.0), not refused.
attestation_evidence that is not a map.

objects.description: A revocation snapshot's header: no cty, no -70001/-70002, no iat.
A typ outside the closed set.
ceg-row/2 is not an object typ.

valid.description: An authored scores row signed by its author.
A counted row (no author; a later group:roster version, counted in CC's model) with refs, a salt, nbf/exp and both redaction forms.
The counted row above signed by a second key, a second voice: same row id, another statement id.
A free-form member as a normalised tag-4 decimal: 123.45 = 4([-2, 12345]), and -0.5 = 4([-1, -5]).
body.note and an array element blinded, both disclosed in sd_claims.
